summary:
The HOLD lane fails. H-G1 and H-G3 fail; H-G2, H-G4, H-G5 and typecheck pass; perf is inconclusive. There are 4 major findings and the lens score is 7.4.

The r11 rebuild is a real step up from r10: the arrangement is deterministic (extents within ~10 px across 6 press moments), and the sequence from the charge through the pop, slab cluster, portal and open frame to the 12/3/6/9 release follows the video. The switches back are bit-exact: `?hold=r10` and `?aphase=r10` match MAIN on 30 and 13 shots, and the default differs only by ring A's 22.50 deg in-plane turn. Exact silhouettes stay inside 1440x766, 1280x800 and 1920x1080 at every press moment, pointer edge and 11 s hold.

It is not yet the video:
1. The release's inner rings snap into a face-on bullseye at F452-F456 instead of the tilted whirl, which is a regression of the QC round 6 fix.
2. The F420 lens has no glowing slit; the orb shows only as a cap.
3. The r11 camera moves on linear keys, so it jolts at F355, F358 and F364 (background speed 6 | 25 | 5 | 0.9 px/frame against the reference's smooth bell).
4. Re-presses and some charges still whip rings at the 900 deg/s clamp (ring C turns ~270 deg in 0.3 s at tau 0).

Smaller misses: the pop's orb crescent (11-12% visible) and over-long B, box misses of 3-13 px, out-in-out quarter paths at F396-F420, early-closing F452 gaps, and the charge in-betweens. Perf could not be judged: the same MAIN build ranged 18.7-40.4 fps at rest under contention, and the CPU cost is negligible in both builds.
